$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$bf16Workspace = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $PSScriptRoot).Path
$bf16Stage = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $bf16Workspace '.scratch/architecture-refactor-2026-10-18/bf16-grouped-bank'))
$bf16StagePrefix = $bf16Stage.TrimEnd('\') + '\'
$bf16Targets = @(
    'C:\public\project-hyle\hyle\.scratch\architecture-refactor-2026-10-18\bf16-grouped-bank\checks\before\control.exe'
    'C:\public\project-hyle\hyle\.scratch\architecture-refactor-2026-10-18\bf16-grouped-bank\checks\before\control.map'
    'C:\public\project-hyle\hyle\.scratch\architecture-refactor-2026-10-18\bf16-grouped-bank\checks\constant\control.exe'
    'C:\public\project-hyle\hyle\.scratch\architecture-refactor-2026-10-18\bf16-grouped-bank\checks\constant\control.map'
    'C:\public\project-hyle\hyle\.scratch\architecture-refactor-2026-10-18\bf16-grouped-bank\checks\constant\new.exe'
    'C:\public\project-hyle\hyle\.scratch\architecture-refactor-2026-10-18\bf16-grouped-bank\checks\constant\new.map'
    'C:\public\project-hyle\hyle\.scratch\architecture-refactor-2026-10-18\bf16-grouped-bank\checks\constant-owned\control.exe'
    'C:\public\project-hyle\hyle\.scratch\architecture-refactor-2026-10-18\bf16-grouped-bank\checks\constant-owned\control.map'
    'C:\public\project-hyle\hyle\.scratch\architecture-refactor-2026-10-18\bf16-grouped-bank\checks\native1\control.exe'
    'C:\public\project-hyle\hyle\.scratch\architecture-refactor-2026-10-18\bf16-grouped-bank\checks\native1\control.map'
    'C:\public\project-hyle\hyle\.scratch\architecture-refactor-2026-10-18\bf16-grouped-bank\checks\native1\new.exe'
    'C:\public\project-hyle\hyle\.scratch\architecture-refactor-2026-10-18\bf16-grouped-bank\checks\native1\new.map'
)
$bf16Protected = @(
    'C:\public\project-hyle\hyle\.scratch\architecture-refactor-2026-10-18\bf16-grouped-bank\checks\native1\tests.exe'
    'C:\public\project-hyle\hyle\.scratch\architecture-refactor-2026-10-18\bf16-grouped-bank\checks\constant-owned\new.exe'
    'C:\public\project-hyle\hyle\.scratch\architecture-refactor-2026-10-18\bf16-grouped-bank\checks\native1\tests.map'
    'C:\public\project-hyle\hyle\.scratch\architecture-refactor-2026-10-18\bf16-grouped-bank\checks\constant-owned\new.map'
)
foreach ($bf16Path in $bf16Targets) {
    $bf16Resolved = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $bf16Path).Path
    if (-not $bf16Resolved.StartsWith($bf16StagePrefix, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { throw "Target outside this batch: $bf16Resolved" }
    if ($bf16Protected -contains $bf16Resolved) { throw "Protected target: $bf16Resolved" }
    if ((Get-Item -LiteralPath $bf16Resolved).PSIsContainer) { throw "Only explicit files may be removed: $bf16Resolved" }
}
[long]$bf16Reclaimed = 0
foreach ($bf16Path in $bf16Targets) {
    $bf16Reclaimed += (Get-Item -LiteralPath $bf16Path).Length
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $bf16Path -Force
}
Write-Output "BF16_GROUPED_RECLAIMED_BYTES=$bf16Reclaimed"
